subject.why: It is clearly a twin-bell alarm clock, complete with bells, hammer, handle, legs, and clock face.

category.why: The clock floats tilted in mid-air with no floor or surface, set against a saturated background with concentric rings.

clean.why: No text, numbers, logos, UI, or frames; clock face smartly uses simple ticks instead of numeral digits.

framing.why: The clock is well-centered with comfortable margins on all edges.

colour.why: The saturated red body contrasts clearly and vibrantly against the rich purple background.

detail.why: No surface noise or micro-details; includes only the requested shake marks.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D volumes with a soft sheen, matching the casual mobile game aesthetic of the references.
